name: teamster
description: Connects Claude Code to a Teamster MCP endpoint and teaches the workflow for routing alerts to Microsoft Teams.

base_url.title: Teamster URL
base_url.description: Base URL of your Teamster admin UI, for example https://teamster.example.com (without /mcp). Not the webhook host, where that is a separate one.

api_token.title: MCP token
api_token.description: A tmcp_ token minted at /admin/tokens on your Teamster server.
